title: A tier-priced part received at a new cost is priced again by its tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a special-order part ordered at a placeholder cost of $0.01, category A, not yet received.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the part's Receive Part window.
  3. Type 40.00 in Received Cost.
  4. Click Receive.
  5. Point at the part's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Receive Part opens with the part's name and a Received Cost box.

Step 3:

  • Received Cost reads 40.00.

Step 4:

  • The part reads $48.60: $40.00 × 1.35 = $54.00 × 0.90 = $48.60.

Step 5:

  • The details show cost $40.00, tier A's 10% off rule and sell price $48.60.
